title: A/B Haiku 5.5 lanes against Sonnet 5.5 on 20 real lanes
body:
Outcome: krn-lane runs on Haiku 5.5 at effort high, escalating to Sonnet 5.5 only on a retry, if an A/B on about 20 real lanes shows the same hidden-test pass rate and Check pass rate at lower dollars per merged PR.
Why: .krn/runs/cc-2.1.322-research/e1 replayed #524, #511 and #525 with the PR's tests hidden (e1/lib.sh): Haiku 5.5 high passed 3/3 at $0.015-0.020 per lane against Sonnet 5.5 medium at $0.086-0.103, but n=1 per cell, 2.7-3.4x wall time and 1.7-2.2x larger diffs on two of three tasks.
Proof: an A/B ledger of at least 20 lanes per arm with pass rates, $/lane (spend-window.py prices Haiku 5.5's over-100K tier), wall time and diff size; the agent definition changes only if Haiku holds pass rate.
Scope: .claude/agents/krn-lane.md, .krn/runs/haiku-lane-ab/.
